findings.direct_evidence: acos(clip(dot(u_hat,v_hat))) returned 2.1073424255447017e-8 rad at an identical-state epoch; frozen-state atan2/chord recomputation gave an orbital-plane maximum of 4.51049031315292e-11 rad.
findings.scientific_consequence: The Manifest 20 1e-8 plane-angle veto was below the estimator floor and cannot support the intended architecture claim.
findings.existing_test_coverage: Manifest 20 recorded that the floor exceeded the gate but retained the historical result.
findings.missing_test: Conditioning suite around sqrt(binary64 epsilon), antiparallel and invalid vectors.
findings.recommended_disposition: Retain history; use atan2 as primary and chord as an independent v2 observer check.

findings.direct_evidence: Direction cosine 0.9999, direction RMS 0.014142..., and MEGNO/LCN 0.001 gates were imported from Manifest 10 implementation-equivalence or same-map contexts and applied to different physical maps over 10 kyr.
findings.scientific_consequence: Those thresholds cannot veto a different-map architecture claim, especially on an interval short relative to the Myr-scale Lyapunov time.
findings.existing_test_coverage: Manifest 20 froze values and provenance text.
findings.missing_test: Explicit threshold-use compatibility contract keyed by trajectory, tangent seed, normalization, rescaling history, coordinates, and map identity.
findings.recommended_disposition: Preserve status and values; classify by original use and preregister future physically justified metrics.

findings.direct_evidence: Coincident positions silently yield zero. The C pointwise API validates key scalars but can return success while nonfinite array inputs produce nonfinite outputs.
findings.scientific_consequence: A malformed state can be hidden at coincidence or detected only after a nonfinite result; frozen runs had finite states and zero nonfinite counters, so no historical result is known to be affected.
findings.existing_test_coverage: Runtime nonfinite-result counter; Step 3g0 reproduces both static cases.
findings.missing_test: Fail-closed v2 API tests for all array/scalar finiteness, positive central mass, and collision policy.
findings.recommended_disposition: Specify strict precondition errors at the v2 boundary; do not alter protected kernels in Step 3g0.

findings.direct_evidence: REBOUND 4.6.0 synchronizes once in the exact-endpoint exit check and once before integrate returns. Each inverse order-17 corrector costs 32 evaluations; 100 omitted exit-check synchronizations account for exactly 3,200 calls.
findings.scientific_consequence: The historical expected-count formula was incomplete; the observed total does not indicate an equation or live-map defect.
findings.existing_test_coverage: Step 3f1 recorded raw and restart counts.
findings.missing_test: Source-derived callback-context ledger with independent counters.
findings.recommended_disposition: Classify CALLBACK_ACCOUNTING_EXACTLY_RECONCILED and separate live/corrector/observer/restart counters in v2.

findings.direct_evidence: Scientific identity and the central GR source are encoded by stable array position, with the Sun required at index 0 and variations contiguous after N_real.
findings.scientific_consequence: The frozen schema/fingerprint protects current order, but reorder or insertion errors are high consequence and difficult to diagnose.
findings.existing_test_coverage: Manifest body order, fingerprints, state body_name/body_index columns, Python/C validation matrix.
findings.missing_test: Typed BodyId-to-index compilation and deliberate index-swap mutant rejection.
findings.recommended_disposition: Make body IDs authoritative and derive a checked immutable layout once.

findings.direct_evidence: Native continuous MEGNO requires synchronized x/v/a and uses cached/restored p_jh with safe_mode=0 and keep_unsynchronized=1.
findings.scientific_consequence: Tangent analysis is entangled with representation transitions; a WHCKL tangent implementation could accidentally perturb the live map or miscount evaluations.
findings.existing_test_coverage: Step 3f0 source audit and Step 3f1 exact restart branches.
findings.missing_test: Observer noninterference and byte-exact internal-state tests after every diagnostic context.
findings.recommended_disposition: Keep live-map ownership separate; update MEGNO only from explicit tangent snapshots after primitive gates pass.

findings.direct_evidence: M0 uses DE431 barycentric ICRF states at 2000-01-01 UTC and DE431-consistent GM values converted by G=6.67430e-11, with no post-extraction recentering.
findings.scientific_consequence: This is a reproducible historical initial-condition model, not an assertion that DE431 is the best modern ephemeris.
findings.recommended_disposition: Freeze ephemeris release and constants as typed provenance; compare modern ephemerides as a separate model question.

findings.direct_evidence: The position-only potential reproduces apsidal precession but has an O(GM/(a*c^2)) mean-motion error; it is not full central-body or N-body 1PN dynamics.
findings.scientific_consequence: It is suitable for a methods baseline and selected secular questions, not ephemeris-grade phase or complete relativistic claims.
findings.existing_test_coverage: Protected force/Jacobian validation, analytic two-body energy and perihelion checks.
findings.missing_test: Future gr and gr_full sensitivity ladder.
findings.recommended_disposition: Label claims by model and keep gr_potential as the first position-only WHCKL tangent target.

findings.direct_evidence: Native variations are rejected for nondefault WHFast kernels in the exact historical runtime.
findings.scientific_consequence: The Step 3f0 combined-lane capability constraint is real and motivates an explicit WHCKL tangent-map implementation.
findings.recommended_disposition: Do not bypass the guard; implement and verify the complete derivative graph in a separate v2 core.

findings.direct_evidence: The lazy kernel shifts Jacobi positions by h^2 A(q)/12, reevaluates acceleration at the shifted state, kicks, then restores positions.
findings.scientific_consequence: Its first variation needs J_A(q)*delta_q and J_A(q_shifted)*delta_q_shifted, but no Hessian or higher derivative.
findings.missing_test: Future finite-difference closure and canonical symplecticity tests for the implemented primitive.
findings.recommended_disposition: Specify a force-plus-JVP interface and preserve exact source ordering.
